layout.description: which partition is which, as inclusive [first, last] ranges

located.description: pictures on the page with bytes to look at

names.description: the described ones, as the graph holds them (at most 4)

app.description: the app it was read in, by the name people know it by

concepts.description: the annotator's concepts, or a person's correction

contentHash.description: 16 hex of SHA-256 over the words and the pictures' addresses

identity.description: the document as the app named it: its path, its URL or its title

identityKey.description: the material's owner-free identity: the bundle id and the document, canonical (`<bundle id>|<path, url or title>`)

precis.description: the annotator's sentence for this revision

description: Replaced when the page is read again. Its partitions are the card (lines `Page: <title>` or `Document: <title>`, `Read in: <app>`, then `At: <url>`, `Summary: <précis>`, `Concepts: <a, b>`, `Pictures: <n> on the page, <m> described` when known), then the page's own words in paragraphs, and the pictures' descriptions (`[Image n] caption — description`); `layout` says which is which. Its Rao Verified record covers the passages only. Searched by meaning.

id.description: `reading-<owner>`, the owner lowercased; the wire group is ambient-<this>
FNV-1a of the owner, lowercased, `|` and the identity key; the document's is ambient/reading/<this>

verified.description: the Rao Verified record, `{record, seal}` (Ambient's AmbientThread/README.md)

title: A reading: one page or document and owner, in ambient-reading-<owner>
